author: RATTLEWARRIOR
title: Can you bait people into punishments

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body: imo there's a difference between what happened and baiting someone into a punishment. In this instance there would be a report of someone spawnkilling, if you watch and the person it close or borderline spawn killing then you have someone stand inside the boundary of spawn killing and if they run inside then they are spawn killing. If they don't, then the goal isn't to spawn kill but rather to kill keep people from getting to a specific spot or area (like the monument).

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

Thanks for the report, but you need to use the support email (support@avicus.net) to report staff members. From my perspective, it really wasn't me trying to "bait" you into spawnkilling, more so to see if you would repeat it since I suspected you of doing it earlier. On the other hand, if a staff member does "bait" you into a punishment, chances are they won't be punished since there isn't a place in the CoC (Code of Conduct) that states they can't do so, along with the fact that you broke a rule, bait or not. If you have any questions, feel free to ask. I'll leave this open for 24 hours.
